goal: Allow local RPC communication over UNIX domain sockets instead of loopback TCP
Lets operators control RPC access using standard filesystem permissions rather than IP allowlists
Reduces networking overhead for local tools communicating with the node
agreement: Strong support with all platform issues and correctness objections resolved
Approach approval citing clean socket abstractions and solid security (winterrdog)
Concept approval noting external tools have long wanted UNIX sockets (winterrdog, b-l-u-e, vasild)
Prior objections on socket collisions, headers, and BSD test failures are resolved (b-l-u-e, winterrdog)
Minor open question on future abstract namespace socket support (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fulfills a decade-old feature request for local UNIX domain socket RPC support
Operators gain OS filesystem permission controls and eliminate loopback TCP overhead
